summary: Backend-only testing of new built-in email autoresponder engine (email_engine.py). Created /app/backend/tests/test_email_engine.py with 15 tests covering admin auth gating (401/403), overview shape & draft-mode (configured=false, no SES keys), templates CRUD + transactional-delete guard, automations CRUD with enrolled/active_runs counters, segments listing (incl. 'All Users'), campaign create→send→queued→delete with suppression skip, suppression CRUD, welcome-on-signup enqueue via /api/auth/register, public open-pixel tracking, unsubscribe link, and SES SNS bounce webhook. Found 1 real bug: trigger_event was failing silently with 'Database objects do not implement truth value testing' because email_engine.py used `if not _db` against a Motor database (which raises NotImplementedError on bool()). This silently broke the welcome-on-signup trigger and the SES delivery webhook handling for opens. Fixed by replacing `not _db` with `_db is None`. After fix, 15/15 tests pass.
action_items: Verify the Motor truth-test fix in email_engine.py (line 292) — already applied by testing agent, but please review the same pattern elsewhere in the codebase to ensure no other `if not _db` / `if db` / `if collection` checks exist against Motor objects.
Optional: add a startup smoke test that calls trigger_event('welcome', {dummy user}) so a regression like this is caught immediately in dev.
critical_code_review_comments: email_engine.py used `if not _db` on a Motor AsyncIOMotorDatabase, which raises NotImplementedError and was swallowed by the broad try/except in trigger_event — silently disabling ALL transactional triggers (welcome, purchase, renewal, ticket_reply). Fixed to `if _db is None`.

trigger_event catches all exceptions and only logs a warning — this hid the bug from normal smoke testing. Consider re-raising in dev or surfacing in /api/admin/email/overview as a 'last_trigger_error' field.
scheduler_loop's `_loop_started` guard is module-level, so on uvicorn --reload the second worker will see it as still True and skip starting; not an issue in production but worth noting.
`/api/admin/email/queue` is hard-capped at 100 rows with no pagination — fine for now but will get noisy in production.
Bcrypt warning in backend logs ('module bcrypt has no attribute __about__') is harmless but noisy; pin passlib/bcrypt versions when convenient (unrelated to email engine).
seed_data_creation: Tests register a few throwaway users (TEST_camp_*, TEST_wel_*, TEST_open_*) via /api/auth/register; they remain in db.users (no destructive cleanup of users by design, but all suppression/campaign/template/automation rows created by the suite are cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_email_engine.py -v` to regress the email engine. Tests use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and admin creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Welcome-on-signup is verified by registering a fresh user and checking /api/admin/email/queue for a `kind=transactional` row. Once AWS SES keys land, expect overview.configured=true and queued rows to flip to status=sent within ~30s (scheduler tick).
rca_of_issue: RCA for the welcome-trigger silent failure: email_engine.trigger_event() began with `if not _db or not user or not user.get('email'): return`. Motor's AsyncIOMotorDatabase explicitly raises NotImplementedError on __bool__ (to force `is None` comparisons). That exception bubbled into the outer try/except which only logged a warning, so register returned 200 normally while no welcome email was ever enqueued. Repro: POST /api/auth/register with a new email, then GET /api/admin/email/queue — pre-fix no row appears and backend.err.log shows 'trigger_event(welcome) failed: Database objects do not implement truth value testing'. Mitigation: changed guard to `if _db is None or not user or not user.get('email')`. Restart backend, re-run pytest — 15/15 pass and the queue row now appears with kind=transactional.
